$comment: Per-exam authoring contract, declared at S3 (exam-author, 2026-08-16). Themes A1-A7 were proposed in derivation/source-warner-ai900.md and are ratified here — the T1-T8 architecture starter set fits this describe-level foundational exam poorly; theme_definitions carries the one-line judgment each theme exercises. A1 (concept-definition) is legitimate only for the handful of definitional seats (C-015, C-016, C-045); everything else is scenario-led per both artefacts' calibration. pattern_extensions E01-E08 are the mechanisms the two Artefact A documents observed that the shared D01-D20 registry does not name (definitions + evidence counts in derivation/source-warner-ai900.md; frequency caps in manifest.validation.pattern_caps — E01 capped at 0.30 as warner's crutch, E08 registered PRECISELY so it can be capped at 0.05: spec-trivia is the dominant pattern of the community AI-900 corpus and is off-blueprint for this exam). Verticals are authored fresh at S3 as AI-use-case settings — none is copied from a source scenario, and the Microsoft documentation personas (Contoso, Fabrikam, Northwind, Tailwind, Adatum) are deliberately not used.

theme_definitions.A1: Concept definition — what a term means or what distinguishes a technique, for the few concepts whose testable idea is the discrimination between adjacent terms
theme_definitions.A2: Service selection — which Azure AI service, or which feature of one service, performs a described task, against near neighbours that perform adjacent jobs
theme_definitions.A3: Workload recognition — which AI workload category a described product or task is, decided by what the output must be
theme_definitions.A4: Technique selection — which machine learning technique the data shape and prediction target demand
theme_definitions.A5: Responsible-AI judgment — which principle a described failure violates, or which action discharges a named principle
theme_definitions.A6: Generative-AI design — model family, prompt shaping, grounding, and layered mitigation chosen from what a scenario needs
theme_definitions.A7: Lifecycle and deployment — split, evaluate, diagnose, deploy and serve decisions across the model lifecycle
